title: ValidationReceiptCandidate
description: MAYOR output. Independent binary civic review of a ClaimCandidate. MAYOR may validate the candidate packet but cannot admit it into kernel truth. ledger_effect: none.

mayor_verdict.description: MAYOR's binary decision. YES = passes to admission queue. NO = rejected here. HOLD = blocked pending evidence.

evidence_inspected.description: Which evidence refs MAYOR actually reviewed. May differ from what HAL listed.

missing_evidence.description: What evidence MAYOR needed but did not find. Empty string if verdict is YES with full evidence.

reason.description: MAYOR's stated reason for the verdict. Compact and specific.

dissent.description: Any reservations MAYOR holds even on YES verdict. What remains uncertain. Empty string if none.

next_gate.description: Where this packet goes next. On YES: ADMISSION_REVIEW. On NO: REJECT_LOG. On HOLD: HOLD_QUEUE.

claim_status.description: Always VALIDATED_CLAIM_CANDIDATE. A YES verdict is not kernel truth.

authority.description: Always false. MAYOR validation is not sovereign authority.

ledger_effect.description: Always none. Validation does not touch the ledger.

actor.description: Always MAYOR. Only MAYOR emits ValidationReceiptCandidates.
